metrics.name: Gross Profit
metrics.description: Revenue minus cost of goods sold

metrics.name: Operating Income
metrics.description: Revenue minus cost of goods sold, operating expenses, and depreciation & amortization (EBIT). CONVENTION: `opex` excludes depreciation and amortization, which are supplied as separate nodes.

metrics.name: EBITDA
metrics.description: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization. CONVENTION: `opex` excludes depreciation and amortization, so no add-back is applied here; use `ebit` / `operating_income` for post-D&A earnings.

metrics.name: EBIT
metrics.description: Earnings before interest and taxes (EBITDA minus depreciation and amortization)

metrics.name: EBT
metrics.formula: revenue - cogs - opex - depreciation - amortization - interest_expense
metrics.description: Earnings before tax. CONVENTION: `opex` excludes depreciation and amortization.

metrics.name: Net Income
metrics.formula: revenue - cogs - opex - depreciation - amortization - interest_expense - tax_expense
metrics.description: Earnings after all expenses and taxes. CONVENTION: `opex` excludes depreciation and amortization.
